name: Ground: the shot, blurred
when: Behind a full-screen graphic whenever the scene has a shot that goes with it (the article's own photo, the place the voice talks about): the recommended ground. One plate per scene, from that scene's own shot.
anchor: None of its own: it starts and ends with the full-screen graphic on top.

vars.plate: the baked plate of this scene's own shot: a 1920x1080 .jpg in the project's assets/ (e.g. assets/ground/SCENE_ID.jpg), made with the recipe
vars.out: seconds: the ground's length, the same as the full-screen graphic on top (make_scene sets the scene's length from it)

recipe_vars.{shot}: the scene's own shot: a video, or a still (a photo in the scene, a wall tile)
recipe_vars.{time}: seconds into {shot} for the frame to use; 0 for a still
recipe_vars.{sigma}: blur: 28 (validated; 26 on a busy wall tile)
recipe_vars.{tint}: strength of the marigold-to-flamingo soft-light tint: 0.40 on a video frame, 0.45 on a bright still (validated)
recipe_vars.{brightness}: darkening: -0.16 on a golden video frame, -0.06 or -0.07 on a bright still (validated)
recipe_vars.{vignette}: PI/8 on a video frame, PI/9 on a still (validated)
recipe_vars.{extra}: null, or a colour fix for a sky that turns mauve once blurred; validated on the article photo: colorbalance=gs=-0.08:gm=-0.04:gh=-0.06:bm=-0.02:bh=-0.04:rh=0.05:rm=0.03,eq=saturation=1.35
recipe_vars.{plate}: the output .jpg in the project's assets/

recipe_validated: bright photo (article scene): {time}=0 {sigma}=28 {tint}=0.45 {brightness}=-0.06 {vignette}=PI/9 {extra}=the colour fix above
placement: Mount it under a full-screen graphic (layer fullscreen) with the same --start, and set out to the graphic's length. Its host goes below the graphic's host in z-index.
source: algrow-gta-pipeline/lab/ground/index.html, preset "footage", plates from tools/prep_grounds.sh + tools/bake_plate.sh (validated as ground-D: out/ground_D.mp4)
changed: The lab drew the ground inside each full-screen scene (one CSS preset for all of them); here it is its own scene, mounted under the graphic. The lab also tinted the cards' shadows on this ground (rgba(18, 8, 10, a) instead of black): shadows belong to the graphic on top, so they are not part of this template. In the lab the article scene faded in over 0.27 s together with its ground; here the ground is simply cut in and the graphic on top does its own entry. The push-in (104 % to 112 %, linear over the length) is a GSAP scale on the plate image instead of the lab's animated background-size: same framing.
